sources: Kardas, Kumar & Epley (2021), Overly shallow? Miscalibrated expectations create a barrier to deeper conversation, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology – 12 experiments, more than 1,800 participants, mostly pairs of strangers; deep and shallow conversations were both less awkward than predicted, deep ones especially; deep conversations were more enjoyable and created more connection; people underestimated how interested their partner would be in them.
